description.value: A culture keeper working three chambers of inherited strain nightward of the frost house, and one of the few trap keepers who will hold a long exchange with a visitor rather than a short one. He refused a symbiont assay in 2291, and again in 2305, on the ground that the review it would feed has been running for twenty-eight years without producing anything he can eat. He declined a photograph on the same occasion and with the same phrasing.
